name: 2-room HDB
notes: Covers 2-room Flexi and older 2-room flats. Below the 3-hour minimum most vendors enforce for recurring work, so a 2-room booking is usually billed as 3 hours regardless of actual time on site.

name: 3-room HDB
notes: The most common flat type in older estates such as Toa Payoh, Ang Mo Kio and Queenstown. Many are 40+ years old, so grout condition and original tile rather than layout is what drives deep-clean time.

name: 4-room HDB
notes: The national default and the size most published price lists quote against. If a vendor advertises a single headline deep-clean price with no size stated, it is almost always the 4-room number.

name: 5-room HDB
notes: Dominant in 1990s towns such as Pasir Ris, Bukit Panjang and Woodlands. Usually three bedrooms plus two bathrooms, and the second bathroom is what pushes a deep clean past the one-day mark for a single cleaner.

name: Executive HDB
notes: Includes executive maisonettes, which are two-storey. A maisonette has an internal staircase and stair balustrades, which add real time to a deep clean and are frequently missed in a quote given over the phone.

name: 1-2 bedroom condo
notes: Smaller than the equivalent HDB but usually with more glass, more built-in joinery and a balcony. Balcony glass and track drainage are the two items most often excluded from a headline price.

name: 3+ bedroom condo
notes: Typically three bathrooms plus a utility or helper's room. Bathroom count, not floor area, is the single biggest driver of deep-clean cost at this size. Condo management may also require vendors to register and show insurance before entering.

name: Landed property
notes: Terrace, semi-detached and detached houses across two to four storeys. Almost always quoted only after a site visit. External areas, car porch and any pool deck are separate line items and are not part of an internal deep clean.
